verdict.rationale: Homebrew is a package manager, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server, an MCP endpoint, or any agent-connection protocol. The closest items are the formulae JSON data API, a CLI, and a 404 llms.txt probe, and these are adjacent building blocks, not an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
